goal: Deploy optimized timeline database to Android hardware/VM, run performance evaluations, setup live demo, and produce Zurich Read Performance specification

steps.description: Apply SQLite read performance optimizations (covering indices, pragmas) to master DB and deploy with correct Android UID/GID permissions
Implement and execute comprehensive performance evaluation suite (Binder latency, SQLite query scans, memory/GC, frame pacing)
Establish live demo interface and verification proofs (Timeline screen capture, Places tab, day navigation)
Author GMS Core Read Performance Technical Specification and Proposal document for Zurich team
Run contract audits and verify repository integrity
Build flawless master v55 database with corrected fprint alignment (full 14,171 catalog places), compliant GMS protobuf wire structures, and gapless temporal coverage through late September 2026
Deploy v55 databases to device/emulator, reset package states, and restart GMS Core and Google Maps
Fix Places tab 15s timeout / 'Maps is offline' error and verify live on-device rendering with actual place counts and categories
Resolve and integrate full 14,171 catalog places into device ODLH using Zurich perf optimizations and valid place index keys
Reconcile Citi Bike stations and dock stops in timeline_viewer.db, eliminate synthetic _e2c suffixes, and ensure canonical ChIJ places across all rides
Compile clean ODLH master database and places/2 cache directly from timeline_viewer.db with zero synthetic injections, zero overlaps, and strict monotonic intervals
Deploy clean master databases to Pixel 8a device, reset caches, and restart GMS Core and Google Maps
Verify single-day rendering fidelity (July 14, 2024 and recent days) on device with XML UI dump and screenshots, confirming zero broken moving segments and clean place cards
